source: Lilly Christian Astrology original 1647 edition, Wellcome b30338724, original PDF598

claims.historical_only_meaning: A standalone unnumbered section begins following a decorated separator on original PDF598, before the next printed chapter.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Kinred viz Brethren and Sisters
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author defines its scope as sibling/kin relationships rather than wealth or planetary financial resources.

groups.description: Preferred first-born chart and chronological scope

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: frame his conjecture especially from the Nativity of the first borne
claims.historical_only_meaning: Lilly prioritizes the first-born child's natal chart to estimate subsequent siblings, instead of assuming all charts are equally informative.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: doth best manifest the number of Brethren and Sisters
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author claims the first-born chart is the best predictor of sibling count but supplies no independent birth records.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: which shall after the Birth succeed or be borne
claims.historical_only_meaning: The proposed count concerns siblings born after the firstborn's birth; the timing restriction cannot be discarded.

groups.description: Alternative natal chart when firstborn unavailable

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: if the Nativity of the first borne cannot be had
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author explicitly allows an alternative when the preferred first-born chart is missing; do not mark such cases invalid by default.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Native ... desirous to know somewhat of the condition and quality
claims.historical_only_meaning: The fallback is aimed at general questions of siblings' condition and qualities, not a quantified medical diagnosis.

groups.description: Three forthcoming questions and their separation

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Whether the Native shall have Brothers or Sisters
claims.historical_only_meaning: The first listed question concerns whether brothers or sisters exist, not the relationship quality or sibling count alone.
The second listed question concerns the alleged condition of siblings, distinct from mere existence.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Whether the Native and they shall live in amity and concord
claims.historical_only_meaning: The third listed question concerns harmony/concord between siblings, not an independent observed relationship.

groups.description: Next independent numbered CXVIII — source navigation only

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXVIII If have Brethren or Sisters
claims.historical_only_meaning: Printed CHAP CXVIII starts below a horizontal divider later on the same original PDF598 and continues into PDF599; its substantive rules are next.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: The Significators of Brethren and Sisters
claims.historical_only_meaning: Only the opening phrase of printed CXVIII is recorded as boundary evidence, not yet admitted as a separate sibling significator rule.
